meaning: Asset count and text-length minimums of a non-retail Performance Max asset group with brand guidelines off, as read from Google's Performance Max asset requirements page during the 2026-10-08 engineering review (finding R13-google-family:pmax-bulk-build-gap) and pinned here. Read again in full on 2026-11-17 (R2.5 M3, Q6, the lead's decision: the raw page, not a summary): every count matched except two maxima, which are re-pinned: LANDSCAPE_LOGO (the page says at most 20 per asset group; the transcription said 5) and YOUTUBE_VIDEO (at most 15; was 5). The page states no combined cap, so the two `combined` entries stay as transcribed on 2026-10-08 and are UNVERIFIED; it does not state the 60-character short-description limit either. Image ratios and sizes, policy and duplicate-text rules stay with Google. The short-description rule (at least one DESCRIPTION of at most 60 characters) is the asset group error SHORT_DESCRIPTION_REQUIRED of the pinned Google Ads v25 Discovery document ("At least one short description asset is required for a valid asset group."); its 60-character limit is transcribed from the same requirements page and is rechecked with the rest.
